notes_for_editor: Only one source reached. Two web searches gave no build date, builder, design, staffing or fire history. The list agrees with the record on name, county, coordinates and standing status. A search surfaced the Faunce tower in the same county; it is a separate record (us-mn-faunce) and was not used here. The record's Wikidata item (Q107507037) was not fetched. Worth checking against a Minnesota DNR or state fire-tower catalog, and the access and visit fields are still unknown.
